svg.title: Quicx component diagram
svg.desc: Producers and workers talk to quicxd over TCP; inside it an event loop and the protocol feed the server, daemon, queue and dispatcher; tasks live in one block of the task pool from SUBMIT until they are sent as TASK.
svg.text: Scope: the quicxd daemon with the adaptive pool (apool v2), and the programs that talk to it
[daemon process · C17 · one thread · no locks]
one thread waits on every socket
a page holds one block size while it has live blocks;
once empty, any size can take it
run one task at a time,
